releaseRules.basic: May release only with explicit evidence status, limitations, requested locale and no unsupported numeric certainty.
releaseRules.pro: Must fail closed without required independent source families, commercial rights, freshness and tier-specific value.
releaseRules.advanced: Must include all Pro gates plus provenance receipt; smart-contract Advanced additionally requires named human-review authority.
releaseRules.all: Fixtures, synthetic data and prepared gates never count as staging or LIVE proof.

executionCadence.duringImplementation: Run corpus verifier only after a coherent product wave; do not generate 2700 outputs repeatedly.
executionCadence.offlineReleaseCandidate: Generate and score all 2700 outputs once after product surfaces are frozen.
executionCadence.staging: Replay only failed/high-risk slices plus provider/payment/database journeys.
executionCadence.live: Use limited cohorts and record real SLO, freshness, false-positive/negative and reviewer SLA evidence.
